controller_revision_note: Before any patch-10 cell, use the original hash-verified E21 proof path for the retained untimed bundle. No frozen bytes changed.
fixture: unchanged D9, 64 pigs and 65 readers per tile
selection: busiest native process CPU over the last five warmup seconds, never reselected
qualification: Inspect untimed main/process/server CPU mean shifts against the maximum within-arm spread, raw P50/P99 on every tile, paired same-tile shifts and all gameplay gates. Changes inside spread are not wins. Timed rows quantify warming separately and cannot establish capacity.
timer_intrusion: Compare timed A to untimed A and timed B to untimed B, reporting main CPU and raw P50/P99 shifts and within-arm ranges. A timer result outside spread is unproven for the original engine.
capacity: No frontier increase is implied by the 650-player qualification. A later frontier claim needs two passes at the highest step and two failures one step above, with unchanged D9 and both CPU caps. Final-stack frontier recheck belongs to the reviewer.
retention: Keep every attempt, including setup failures, and never select replacement observations after a result. Release the window before analysis.
